qa_pair.question: Using the 9 September 2026 AMIRA snapshot, discover the publication types for French-language publications, then verify the article total with search_publications. Return total French publications and French articles as two integers separated by a comma and space.

Use the collection overview and publication language facet for the 9 September 2026 snapshot to determine how many publications lack language metadata. Return the missing count as an integer; do not infer missing languages from a single search page.
Look up epub-9405 and eref-95983 separately using get_publication. Verify they resolve to the same record and return its common amira_url, without Markdown formatting.

For the 9 September 2026 snapshot, compare the collection overview's full-text publication count with search_publications filtered by has_fulltext=true. Return the total count after verifying the two agree.

Export all French-language publications as RIS using search_publications on the 9 September 2026 snapshot. Follow next_offset until has_more is false, count the complete entries, and compare that count with list_publication_facets filtered to French. Return the matching total as an integer.
Read publication 29949 and identify its thesis adviser Kaime, Thoko. Return the adviser's linked AMIRA authority URL from the publication detail, without constructing a URL from the person's name.
